title.zh: 复盘：共同计划减少了哪一处困惑
title.en: Review the confusion a shared plan actually resolves

paragraphs.zh: 沿用底座、纸结构和虚构路线的三步安排，先让创作者各选愿做的部分，再检查顺序是否仍适合。只改一处不合的衔接，也可删去多余协调。可以只画任务卡。复盘看计划是否好用、能修改，不用采纳率评服从、忠诚或领导，更不替别人默认为新增任务作承诺。
paragraphs.en: For the base, paper structures and imagined route, let contributors choose their parts before checking the sequence. Revise one awkward transition or remove unnecessary coordination. Sketch task cards only if preferred. Review a usable, editable plan without acceptance as obedience, loyalty or leadership, and without committing anyone to added tasks.

title.zh: 借和平纸展示比较选择
title.en: Compare choices through a peaceful paper display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果三步展示计划中有人想缩小贡献，怎样改一个衔接，让其余安排仍清楚而不自动给别人加任务？”各拟一种办法，再从另一战团的本版角度改一处。可只用原创草图想象，不需收藏、购物、参赛或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If someone reduced their part in a three-step display plan, how would you revise one transition without silently adding work for others?” Offer an approach each and revise through another Chapter’s angle in this edition. Use original sketches without collecting, shopping, competing or sharing personal experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享不含答卷和计数的公开说明。六名称只对应本版爱好选项，不是官方分派、配军建议、军事能力、意识形态、基因、身体价值或族群标签；官方名称资料不验证题本。对方可换战团、不同意、不回答或结束，不推断真人隐私、健康和道德，也不评价缺席者。
paragraphs.en: Share the public guide without answers or counts. Six names concern this edition’s hobby options, not official assignments, army-building advice, military ability, ideology, genetics, bodily worth or ethnic labels; official naming sources do not validate the bank. Others may change Chapters, disagree, decline or stop. Infer no private history, health or morality, and label no absent person.

title.zh: 复盘：轻纸部件够用的底座即可
title.en: Review a base sufficient for the lightweight piece

paragraphs.zh: 沿用同一个轻纸部件，比两种纸支撑时保留相同展示位置，记录是否少了反复摆回。只做普通桌面观察，不施压、加重或追求不可动摇；也可只比草图。复盘问哪版够用、是否还想继续，不以结实程度评身体力量、韧性、个人可靠或为别人撑场的义务。
paragraphs.en: For the same lightweight paper piece, compare two paper supports in the same display position and note whether repeated resetting decreases. Observe normally on a table without pressure, added weight or an unshakeable target; compare sketches only if preferred. Review sufficiency and willingness to continue without sturdiness as strength, resilience, personal reliability or a duty to support others.

title.zh: 借和平纸展示比较选择
title.en: Compare choices through a peaceful paper display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一个小纸部件只需展示一下午，怎样比较两种简单底座，并在够用时停下？”各拟一种办法，再从另一战团的本版角度改一处。可只用原创草图想象，不需收藏、购物、参赛或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a small paper piece needed one afternoon’s display, how would you compare two simple bases and stop when sufficient?” Offer an approach each and revise through another Chapter’s angle in this edition. Use original sketches without collecting, shopping, competing or sharing personal experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：只改一个连接，再比较是否有用
title.en: Review one changed connection for a useful difference

paragraphs.zh: 沿用纸接合，把旧折法和只改一处的新折法放同一小样条件下比，先问作者愿不愿改，再记录可见差别。没有帮助就回旧版或结束，不把每次新版本称为进步。可以只画前后图。复盘针对纸物适配，不评效率人格、技术资格、身体改造态度或人的产出价值。
paragraphs.en: For the paper joint, compare the old fold and a one-part revision under the same sample conditions, asking the maker before changing it. Record the visible difference, restore or stop if unhelpful, and call no new version progress automatically. Draw before and after only. Review paper fit rather than an efficiency personality, technical qualification, body modification or human value through output.

title.zh: 借和平纸展示比较选择
title.en: Compare choices through a peaceful paper display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一条纸连接不合，怎样先约一处可改回的变化，再决定留新版、回旧版或停止？”各拟一种办法，再从另一战团的本版角度改一处。可只用原创草图想象，不需收藏、购物、参赛或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a paper connection did not fit, how would you agree one reversible change and choose the revision, original or stopping?” Offer an approach each and revise through another Chapter’s angle in this edition. Use original sketches without collecting, shopping, competing or sharing personal experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：一处纸质地，不必追到无瑕
title.en: Review one paper texture without demanding flawlessness

paragraphs.zh: 沿用已有材料的两张微小表面样，保留大小和观看位置，只换一个折痕或层次，描述各给虚构场景什么感觉。先约愿花的时间，能留粗版、都不留或存到以后；也可只描述。复盘记录制作乐趣，不以细致程度评艺术天赋、爱心或品位，不需要新器材、热源或真实工具试验。
paragraphs.en: For two tiny surface samples from available paper, keep size and viewing position while changing one fold or layer. Describe their effects on the invented scene and agree a time limit. Keep a rough version, neither or a later idea; describe only if preferred. Review making enjoyment without detail as artistic talent, care or taste, and without new equipment, heat or tool experiments.

title.zh: 借和平纸展示比较选择
title.en: Compare choices through a peaceful paper display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果还有时间添一处纸质地，怎样只比一个折痕或层次，并保留简单收尾的选择？”各拟一种办法，再从另一战团的本版角度改一处。可只用原创草图想象，不需收藏、购物、参赛或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If there was time for one paper texture, how would you compare a fold or layer and keep a simple finish available?” Offer an approach each and revise through another Chapter’s angle in this edition. Use original sketches without collecting, shopping, competing or sharing personal experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：看见什么，与为什么发生分开
title.en: Review a visible feature separately from its cause

paragraphs.zh: 沿用重排时移动的纸部件，先写位置、移动方向与出现在哪次普通操作，再把原因留作问题。问作者是否有意、是否想改，不暗中观察人或猜私人动机。可只看自制草图。复盘检查描述能否被核对，不以看得多证明洞察、内向、怀疑或读心，也容许最后无需修改。
paragraphs.en: For the piece moving during rearrangement, record location, direction and the ordinary action when it moved, leaving cause as a question. Ask the maker whether it is intended and whether change is wanted, without covert observation or guessed motives. Inspect a self-made sketch only. Review checkable description rather than insight, introversion, suspicion or mind-reading, with no change also possible.

title.zh: 借和平纸展示比较选择
title.en: Compare choices through a peaceful paper display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果纸部件重排后移了一点，怎样只描述可见变化，再问作者它是否有意、想不想改？”各拟一种办法，再从另一战团的本版角度改一处。可只用原创草图想象，不需收藏、购物、参赛或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a paper piece shifted after rearrangement, how would you describe the visible change before asking whether it was intended or needed revision?” Offer an approach each and revise through another Chapter’s angle in this edition. Use original sketches without collecting, shopping, competing or sharing personal experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：同样部件的两条想象路线
title.en: Review two imagined routes through the same pieces

paragraphs.zh: 沿用同一组纸结构，在两张草图上只改进入方向或连接次序，分别说各能先注意什么。共享部件先不动，愿意的伙伴可选任一、组合或保持原路。复盘比较虚构浏览体验，不竞速、不试身体动作，也不推断反应、冒险、族群身份或应付现实重大改变的能力。
paragraphs.en: For the same paper structures, change only an approach direction or connection order in two sketches and describe what each reveals first. Leave shared pieces untouched while willing partners choose either, combine or keep the original. Review the invented viewing experience without racing, physical trials or inferences about reflexes, risk, ethnicity or handling major real change.

title.zh: 借和平纸展示比较选择
title.en: Compare choices through a peaceful paper display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果保留同一组纸结构，只换进入方向，两条路各会先看见什么，又怎样让人保留原路线？”各拟一种办法，再从另一战团的本版角度改一处。可只用原创草图想象，不需收藏、购物、参赛或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If the paper structures stayed the same but the approach changed, what would each route reveal first and how would the original remain available?” Offer an approach each and revise through another Chapter’s angle in this edition. Use original sketches without collecting, shopping, competing or sharing personal experiences.
